solves: Leads the person to a page from the collapsed lateral menu, where only the icon fits, with the name in a balloon, the current page marked and, when needed, a counter.
use_when: In the collapsed menu, where only the icon fits.
With counter, when the page has something to look at.
do_not_use_when: In the expanded menu: use nph-sidebar-item, with the visible label.
With text in the counter: use nph-badge.
As an action button: use nph-button.

label.constraint: The name of the page, already localized. Required: it is the aria-label of the link and the text of the balloon, which is always on. Without it, the rail button draws nothing and emits console.error in development; with no label and no icon, it is a mount and emits nothing.

icon.constraint: A core name of nph-icon, drawn at icon/size-md: light at rest, solid when active. Empty or outside the core draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

href.constraint: The page it leads to. Required unless disabled: without it, the rail button draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

active.constraint: The current page: aria-current="page", sidebar/rail-background-active and the solid icon in sidebar/rail-foreground-active.

counter.constraint: A whole number from zero up, in a pill on the top end corner (D-1), read in the name of the link, after the label (WCAG 2.5.3; Elvys, 27-10-2026). When active, the pill gains an outline in sidebar/panel-background (D-2). Anything else draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

disabled.constraint: The page exists, but the person has no access now: state/disabled-opacity, out of the Tab order, with no click and no balloon. A disabled rail button needs no href.

counter.choose_when: on when the page has something to look at; off in every other case.

rest.changes_for_user: No background: the light icon in sidebar/item-foreground.

hover.changes_for_user: The button in sidebar/rail-background-hover; the balloon opens after the wait.

active.changes_for_user: The current page: sidebar/rail-background-active and the solid icon in sidebar/rail-foreground-active; the counter gains its outline.

focus.changes_for_user: Keyboard focus: border border/width in color/primary and halo focus/ring-width in focus/halo around the button; the balloon opens at once.

disabled.changes_for_user: The whole button at state/disabled-opacity, with no hover and no balloon; it cannot be reached by Tab.

business_rules: The balloon is always on, with the label: without a visible label, it says the name.
nph-sidebar switches nph-sidebar-item for the rail button when it collapses.
A click on the balloon is not a click on the button: it stops at the host.

tokens.icon: nph-icon icon/size-md in sidebar/item-foreground, light; solid in sidebar/rail-foreground-active when active
tokens.counter: text/label-sm in sidebar/item-badge-foreground on sidebar/item-badge-background, icon/size-md high, space/inline on the sides, radius/full, on the top end corner; outline border/width in sidebar/panel-background when active
tokens.focus: border border/width in color/primary, focus/border-radius-container; halo focus/ring-width in focus/halo, focus/radius-container

ai_hints: Use nph-sidebar-rail-button in the collapsed menu only; in the expanded menu, use nph-sidebar-item.
Give every rail button the label of the page: it is its only name.
Use the same icon as the item it replaces.

accessibility.semantics: A link with aria-current=page on the current page. Disabled, the link has no href, keeps role link and gains aria-disabled.
accessibility.accessible_name: The label and then the counter number: aria-labelledby reads the balloon, whose text is the label, and the counter, so the name holds the number one sees (WCAG 2.5.3; Elvys, 27-10-2026). The aria-label is the label, the fallback; disabled, with no balloon, it holds the label and the counter. The icon is hidden from the screen reader.
keyboard: Tab: reaches the button and opens the balloon.
accessibility.focus: Border color/primary and halo focus/halo around the button, keyboard only.
accessibility.contrast: The icon passes 3:1 against sidebar/panel-background, sidebar/rail-background-hover on hover and sidebar/rail-background-active when active, and the number passes 4.5:1 against sidebar/item-badge-background, in both modes. Disabled is exempt.
accessibility.color_alternative: Active also gains its background and switches the icon to solid; the counter carries the number as text.

invalid_combinations: A rail button without label — it would have no name.
An icon empty or outside the core — the rail button draws nothing.
A rail button without href, unless disabled — it leads nowhere.
A counter that is not a whole number from zero up — the counter shows a number only.
anti_patterns: Leaving the rail button without its name.
Using the rail button in the expanded menu.
Using the rail button as an action button.

sources.design_md: design.md, color/primary, focus/halo, focus/ring-width, border/width, space/inline, icon/size-md, radius/container, radius/full, text/label-sm and state/disabled-opacity; the sidebar/* tokens and the focus radii are in src/tokens/source/semantic.tokens.json
sources.decision: P98 — API and semantics of nph-sidebar-item, nph-sidebar-subitem and nph-sidebar-rail-button
sources.usage_evidence: the Rail button section and the required examples of the nph-sidebar-item Docs page
